label: prop:reeb-bundle-complement-equals-volume
title: Reeb-bundle complement is the JSJ-graded volume sum (Reeb-bundle face of mass-volume)
html:
Proposition. Reeb-bundle complement is the JSJ-graded volume sum (Reeb-bundle face of mass-volume)

Proposition (conditional on conj:mass-volume-factorization). Let \mathcal{R}_p \cong S^3 be the Reeb bundle. Let K_\beta denote the closure of the colour-tube trajectory under \beta \in B_3. The categorical Markov-trace observable equals the JSJ-graded sum over the hyperbolic pieces P_i of the knot complement \mathcal{R}_p \setminus \nu(K_\beta):

  \mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(\rho(\beta)\bigr) \;=\; \sum_{P_i \text{ hyperbolic}} \rho_F(P_i)\,V_{\mathrm{hyp}}(P_i),

where V_{\mathrm{hyp}} is the Thurston volume and \rho_F(P_i) is the Frobenius packing density.

This presents the geometric face of the mass-volume factorisation conjecture. The observable evaluates inside the Reeb bundle. Its value equals the hyperbolic volume of its complement. Pure-rotation 3-cycles trace Heegaard torus trajectories, leaving a Seifert-fibered complement where V_{\mathrm{hyp}} = 0. Non-torus compositions cross Heegaard tori, leaving a hyperbolic complement with positive volume.
